pull-request-header:
:rocket: **Release PR** — merge to cut the next version.

- :white_check_mark: **Squash and merge** this PR — do _not_ create a merge commit — so the title becomes the `chore(release)` commit on `main`.
- :label: Merging bumps `package.json`, finalizes `CHANGELOG.md`, tags `vX.Y.Z`, and cuts a GitHub Release.
- :package: `CHANGELOG.md` is what the Marketplace renders as the extension's **Changelog** tab, so keep the conventional-commit types accurate.
- :robot: Auto-generated by [release-please](https://github.com/googleapis/release-please) from Conventional Commits — re-run on every push to `main`.
